findingDetails.title: sk-code-obsidian section 2b sentence still mixes prefixed and bare file names
findingDetails.case: A reader meets three references/-prefixed names beside three bare names (accessibility.md, theme-variables.md, skill-reference-integrity.md) that resolve from no base of the root file.
findingDetails.evidence: The preceding sentence (line 177) prefixes all six; SKILL.md 2b carries references/accessibility.md:135, references/theme-variables.md:136 and references/skill-reference-integrity.md:126; the checker token gate (validate-playbook-package.cjs:415) requires a slash, so the bare tokens were never warnings and were left behind.
findingDetails.userImpact: Minor reader confusion only; no checker output or runtime behavior changes.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The six names appear in exactly two sentences in the file; no other root playbook mixes forms on a rewritten line.
findingDetails.recommendation: Prefix the remaining three tokens with references/ to match section 2b and the preceding sentence.
